verses.text: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the mountains; From where shall my help come?
verses.textZh: （上行之詩。）我要向山舉目；我的幫助從何而來？

verses.text: My help [comes] from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textZh: 我的幫助從造天地的耶和華而來。

verses.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.textZh: 他必不叫你的腳搖動；保護你的必不打盹！

verses.text: Behold, He who keeps Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.textZh: 保護以色列的，也不打盹也不睡覺。

verses.text: The LORD is your keeper; The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
verses.textZh: 保護你的是耶和華；耶和華在你右邊蔭庇你。

verses.text: The sun will not smite you by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.textZh: 白日，太陽必不傷你；夜間，月亮必不害你。

verses.text: The LORD will protect you from all evil; He will keep your soul.
verses.textZh: 耶和華要保護你，免受一切的災害；他要保護你的性命。

verses.text: The LORD will guard your going out and your coming in From this time forth and forever.
verses.textZh: 你出你入，耶和華要保護你，從今時直到永遠。
